notes.title: Holiday Characters Expansion
notes.content:
Nari and Medjay now have their own playable stages:

- Nari stage unlockable at the female world after acquiring 41 golden paws
- Medjay stage unlockable at the male world after 41 male golden paws

Of course, those stages is a gift for everyone who liked our protagonists, but they're not cannon to our plot.  

Like Medjay and Nari would ever be caught by some silly octopus! 
  
Thank you to everyone who gave our game a chance, we're extremelly grateful to you. 

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Infinity Mode Update
notes.content:
- New game mode added (Infinity Mode) where you can find all the characters you've already unlocked in a continuous play style.

- Huge performance optmizations on play mode.

notes.title: Male Characters Expansion and Extras
notes.content:
[u][b]MALE EXPANSION PACK IS FINALLY HERE![/b][/u]

Our male furry contest winners are now presented for our players as a free update for the main game! 

No need for any extra purchases or extra fees to access our new content. We felt it should be part of our [b]main game[/b] and not a DLC. 

- 5 new male characters with unique traits and personalities
- 10 new plots for our protagonists matching our new male characters
- 5 new scenarios to match the stages progression 
- Game translated to Latam spanish, can be changed on the settings menu
- Various minor Ui fixes 

We hope you enjoy our new content and we're still completing our product, so expect to see more free expansions in the future!

notes.title: v1.14 Mouse and Cursor updates
notes.content:
- After a few seconds not being used the keyboard and gamepad cursor will vanish from the board. 

- Swipe min length increased in a attempt to fix erronious direction swiping computing.

notes.title: V 1.13 Mouse gameplay, mapping screen and resolution settings fix
notes.content:
- At first we decided not to enable mouse input because we didn't want to be so easily compared to match 3 mobile mechanics, but turns out it's better to allow players to play whataver they feel more confortable with. We enabled the mouse swipe gameplay. 

- We now show the input mapping the first time the player enters a stage. Players can see all the key bindings without having to enter the menu on their first time playing a stage. 

- Settings had a problem where after you closed the game and reopened then entered settings again the game would reset the resolution to the native one. This is not happening anymore. 

Special thanks:
jongizombie for pointing those issues to us.

notes.title: V1.11 - Character cleared stage fix
notes.content:
After beating a stage once, beating it with another character only counted if the score was higher than the first character's score. 

Now it is fixed, beating with any amount of score will count as character's stage cleared status. 

We're sorry for any incovenience this might have caused.

notes.title: V 1.1 - Difficulty settings
notes.content:
Issue: Players reported having a hard time getting through the various stage of the game. 

Solution:
Since we understand that not everyone is looking for a tough challenge and some just want a mindless casual fun (and take a peek at some hot furries) we decided to let players choose the difficult level they're most confortable with in the title screen. 

We hope this will make the user experience less frustrating for all players skills, not making the game too easy for pro tetris attackers nor too hard for new players. 

Special Thanks: 
Kitiana Foxtail for being so supportive in helping finding the best settings for this update.

notes.title: V1.01 Difficulty Update
notes.content:
Seeing people struggling with the game we decided to greatly reduce the overral difficulty of the first levels and moderately the later ones. 

This way we expect people to feel less frustrated on the first touch with the game. 

For good players there will still be a nice challenge after you clear the first 2 worlds. We did not change the extra world's difficulty. 

Thanks for your support!
